body:
Touching a menu action inside a dialog did nothing in WebKit, so a card could not be deleted from its editor on a phone. Fixed in 48c697b and running in the existing HTTPS app.

Still open for the owner: a card pinned to Focus is refused by the server (CARD_IN_FOCUS) and must be unpinned and reopened first. Evidence: progress/2026-10-06-touch-menu-actions.md.

metadata.summary: Touched menu actions work in WebKit dialogs
